skills.name: Thousand-Mile Tailwind
skills.description: Mazu heals the weakest allied unit for HP equal to 200% of ATK plus 10% of lost HP.

upgrades.level2: Mazu heals the weakest allied unit for HP equal to 250% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: This healing effect applies to 1 additional allied unit.
upgrades.level4: The healing effect based on lost HP increases to 25%.

skills.name: Moon Blocks Divination
skills.description: When entering battle, all allied units cast moon blocks once. If the Sacred Blocks are cast, they gain 100 Energy and a 45% ATK increase.

upgrades.level2: If the Sacred Blocks are cast, they gain a 50% ATK bonus.
upgrades.level3: If the Sacred Blocks are cast, they gain a 55% ATK bonus.
upgrades.level4: If the Sacred Blocks are cast, they gain a 60% ATK bonus.

skills.name: Holy Mother of Heaven
skills.description: For each surviving ally, Mazu takes 10% less DMG and increases Energy Regen over time by 5%.

upgrades.level2: For each surviving ally, Mazu takes 15% less DMG.
upgrades.level3: For each surviving ally, Energy Regen over time increases by 10%.
upgrades.level4: For each surviving ally, Mazu takes 20% less DMG.

skills.name: Mercy's Wake
skills.description: Mazu grants all allied units a Shield equal to 200% of ATK. For the next 8s, 40% of the DMG they take is instead taken slowly over 5s.

upgrades.level2: Grants all allied units a Shield equal to 300% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Grants all allied units a Shield equal to 400% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Grants all allied units a Shield equal to 500% of ATK.

relic.name: Merciful Salvation
relic.description: When Mercy's Wake is cast, increases allied units' ATK by 30% for 8s.

upgrades.level10: Mercy's Wake causes 50% of the DMG allied units take to be taken slowly over the next 5s.
upgrades.level20: Mazu gains 200% Energy upon entering battle.
upgrades.level30: Mercy's Wake causes 50% of the DMG allied units take to be taken slowly over the next 7s.

coreMechanic.summary: Team-wide protection and ATK support. Mercy's Wake shields all allies and spreads part of their incoming DMG over several seconds, Moon Blocks Divination can grant the whole team Energy and ATK at battle start, and Thousand-Mile Tailwind heals the weakest allies. Mazu takes less DMG for each surviving ally, so she is strongest while the team stays alive.
